import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Extract species names EXACTLY from sample_submission for consistency
species_columns = [col for col in sample_submission.columns if col != "id"]
print(f"Species count: {len(species_columns)}")

# Create species mapping (ensure consistency with sample_submission)
species_to_idx = {species: idx for idx, species in enumerate(species_columns)}
idx_to_species = {idx: species for idx, species in enumerate(species_columns)}

# Feature columns - must exclude id and species columns
feature_columns = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Number of feature columns: {len(feature_columns)}")

# Prepare training data - ensure proper type casting
X_train = train_df[feature_columns].values.astype(np.float64)
y_train_idx = train_df["species"].map(species_to_idx).values

# Calculate min class size to determine maximum safe CV folds
unique_classes, counts = np.unique(y_train_idx, return_counts=True)
min_class_size = int(counts.min())
max_safe_folds = min_class_size - 1 if min_class_size > 0 else 5
print(f"Minimum class size: {min_class_size}, Max safe CV folds: {max_safe_folds}")

# Split into training and validation sets (stratified to preserve class balance)
# Hold out 20% for proper validation - model should NEVER see this data during training
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_final, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_idx, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_idx
)

print(f"Training size: {X_train_final.shape[0]}, Validation size: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# IMPROVEMENT: Add StandardScaler for numerical stability across all features
# This provides consistent feature distributions and improves convergence
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_final)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(test_df[feature_columns].values.astype(np.float64))

# Perform parameter grid search with tuned hyperparameters optimized for leaf classification
param_grid = {"n_estimators": [500], "max_depth": [15, 20], "min_samples_leaf": [3, 5]}

# Create CV splitter with max folds equal to min class size minus one
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=max_safe_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    estimator=RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42),
    param_grid=param_grid,
    cv=cv,
    scoring="neg_log_loss",
    verbose=0,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train_final)

print(f"Best parameters: {grid_search.best_params_}")
print(f"Best CV score: {-grid_search.best_score_:.6f}")

# Get best model
best_model = grid_search.best_estimator_

# Final validation set evaluation - model was NOT trained on this data
y_pred_proba_val = best_model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, y_pred_proba_val)
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set (providing unlabeled data)
proba_test = best_model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)

# Clip probabilities to avoid numerical issues (as per instructions)
proba_test = np.clip(proba_test, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission dataframe with correct column order matching sample_submission
submission_data = {"id": test_df["id"].to_list()}

for i, species in enumerate(species_columns):
    prob_values = proba_test[:, i].tolist()
    submission_data[species] = prob_values

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(
    "Evaluation Metric (Multi-class Log Loss): {val_logloss:.6f}".format(
        val_logloss=val_logloss
    )
)
